Asset type: premium desktop wallpaper, landscape 16:9, 3840 x 2160.
Create a breathtaking yet restrained abstract wallpaper titled "Tide / midnight". Extreme close-up of a continuous wide sculptural sheet of liquid satin, flowing in two or three immense soft sweeping folds from lower left across the lower middle and curling up at the right edge. It feels like a macro photograph of silk and anodized titanium merging, with physically convincing three-dimensional curvature and very soft brushed microtexture. Deep ink-purple background (#110c1d), violet and dark aubergine body, thin luminous lavender edges with a tiny restrained silver-blue reflection. Broad shadows, beautiful smooth gradients, precise refined art direction, elegant cinematic studio lighting. Sculptural flowing landscape, not an isolated object on a pedestal. The upper third is calm uninterrupted dark negative space for desktop usability. Full-bleed composition with forms continuing beyond the frame. Sophisticated, tactile, quiet, not busy. No text, no logo, no watermark, no border, no UI, no stars, no particles, no neon glow, no ring or torus, no obvious vector shapes. One single finished artwork, not a collage or mockup. Generate at 3840 x 2160 if supported.

Deep aubergine shadows, muted violet sand, slender lilac dusk highlights along the crests. Tactile impossibly fine wind-combed sand, mostly smooth at desktop scale. Almost-black indigo-violet sky filling the upper third, soft atmospheric depth, horizon fading into darkness. Quiet, sensual, spacious, carefully composed, premium photographic realism. Subtle restrained color, broad smooth surfaces with exquisite curved edge lighting. No objects, no moons, no stars, no people, no plants, no structures, no logos, no text, no watermark, no particles, no neon. A beautiful landscape you would actually use all day as a wallpaper, full bleed, not a mockup or collage.
